glosses: destiny, fate (irresistible power that predetermines events)
life story; the general conditions and main developments of a person's life; more often than in English used without any notion of predetermination

examples.text: Mein Schicksal ist in deinen Händen.
examples.en: My fate is in your hands.

examples.text: Du bist der Herr deines Schicksals.
examples.en: You're the master of your own destiny.
She had to accept her fate.

examples.text: Ihr Schicksal war, jung zu sterben.
examples.en: It was her fate to die young.
